digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow model resolution and class-based escalation
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are bare Anthropic model IDs that resolve to provider anthropic even when configured for another provider, causing split-brain execution across multiple batch runners and the default runner

MODEL_LADDER serves dual purposes (escalation order and P8 context budget) such that expressing ladder rungs as class names would break substring matching in largest_window_tokens without explicitly decoupling the two concerns
The ladder resolution sites—production_batch_runner, code_review/batch_runner, and workflow/runners—directly copy model_ladder[0] without resolving class names, bypassing the class config
models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic model IDs for escalation even when the primary model is Bedrock-qualified, causing silent provider drift on context limit escalation

Reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) in the step model: value space can unify ladder and step model resolution through a single resolve_model_string function without schema changes or new keys
